name: soma
description: Deterministic behavioral synthesis, measurement, and capture primitives

scripts.build:ext: bun build ext/src/capture.ts --outfile ext/dist/capture.js --target browser --minify && bun build ext/src/background.ts --outfile ext/dist/background.js --target browser --minify && bun build ext/src/popup/popup.ts --outfile ext/dist/popup.js --target browser --minify
scripts.train:flow: python3 flow/train_flow.py --epochs 50 --lr 1e-3 --batch 1024 --seed 42 --out flow/flow.pt --onnx-out model/flow.onnx && python3 flow/export_stats.py --flow flow/flow.pt --out model/flow.stats.json && bun run build
